description: A cream full-length dress with a high boat-like neckline close to the collarbones, opaque long sleeves to the wrists, and gold floral or geometric woven-looking borders around the neck, cuffs and long vertical front panels. The bodice is softly fitted with a narrow ornate belt and a central reddish jewel-like ornament. A deep burgundy outer wrap drapes from brooch fastenings at the shoulders, with broad gold patterned edging and folds hanging down both sides. The skirt is closed and floor-length; a decorated dark shoe appears beneath the hem. Exact fibres cannot be confirmed from the image.
